"""mindmap_work_get — read one work item with its workflow position and available moves."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import ClassVar
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mem_mcp.db import tenant_tx
from mem_mcp.mcp.tool_descriptions import TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._base import BaseTool, ToolContext
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._mindmap_common import resolve_team_id
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._work_item_common import (
    AllowedMoveOutput,
    WorkItemSignoffStateOutput,
    WorkItemWithMovesOutput,
    map_work_item_error,
)
from mem_mcp.mindmap import work_items as work_item_service
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_errors import WorkflowError
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_reads import AllowedMove, compute_item_moves


class MindmapWorkGetInput(BaseModel):
    """Input for reading a single work item."""

    map_key: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    node_id: UUID
    team_id: UUID | None = Field(default=None)


def summarize_moves(
    moves: list[AllowedMove],
) -> tuple[list[AllowedMoveOutput], str | None, WorkItemSignoffStateOutput | None]:
    """Convert domain moves to output models plus item-level blocked_reason / pending_signoff."""
    outputs = [AllowedMoveOutput(**vars(m)) for m in moves]
    pending: WorkItemSignoffStateOutput | None = None
    for m in moves:
        if m.request_id is not None and m.signoff_min is not None:
            pending = WorkItemSignoffStateOutput(
                request_id=m.request_id,
                to_stage=m.to_stage,
                signoff_min=m.signoff_min,
                signatory_count=m.signatory_count,
                remaining=m.remaining,
                eligible_to_sign=m.eligible_to_sign,
            )
            break
    blocked: str | None = None
    if moves and all(m.blocked_reason == "role_restricted" for m in moves if m.transition_id is not None) and any(
        m.transition_id is not None for m in moves
    ):
        blocked = "role_restricted"
    elif pending is not None:
        blocked = f"awaiting {pending.remaining} sign-offs"
    return outputs, blocked, pending


def build_with_moves(
    wi: work_item_service.WorkItem, moves: list[AllowedMove], map_key: str, request_id: str
) -> WorkItemWithMovesOutput:
    allowed, blocked, pending = summarize_moves(moves)
    return WorkItemWithMovesOutput(
        node_id=wi.memory_id,
        map_key=map_key,
        map_state=wi.map_state,
        kind=wi.kind,
        status=wi.status,
        assignee_id=wi.assignee_id,
        title=wi.title,
        created_by=wi.created_by,
        created_at=wi.created_at,
        updated_at=wi.updated_at,
        status_changed_at=wi.status_changed_at,
        request_id=request_id,
        current_stage=wi.current_stage or wi.status,
        allowed_moves=allowed,
        blocked_reason=blocked,
        pending_signoff=pending,
    )


class MindmapWorkGetTool(BaseTool):
    """Get a work item with current_stage, allowed_moves, blocked_reason, pending_signoff."""

    name: ClassVar[str] = "mindmap_work_get"
    description: ClassVar[str] = TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS["mindmap_work_get"]
    required_scope: ClassVar[str] = "memory.read"
    InputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = MindmapWorkGetInput
    OutputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = WorkItemWithMovesOutput

    async def __call__(self, ctx: ToolContext, inp: BaseModel) -> BaseModel:
        assert isinstance(inp, MindmapWorkGetInput)

        async with tenant_tx(ctx.db_pool, ctx.tenant_id) as conn:
            team_id = await resolve_team_id(conn, ctx, inp.team_id)
            try:
                wi = await work_item_service.get_work_item(
                    conn,
                    tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                    team_id=team_id,
                    map_key=inp.map_key,
                    node_id=inp.node_id,
                )
                moves = await compute_item_moves(
                    conn,
                    tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                    team_id=team_id,
                    map_key=inp.map_key,
                    node_id=inp.node_id,
                    viewing_tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                )
            except (work_item_service.WorkItemError, WorkflowError) as e:
                raise map_work_item_error(e) from e

            return build_with_moves(wi, moves, inp.map_key, ctx.request_id)
EOF

"""mindmap_work_list — list a map's work items with workflow position and available moves."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import ClassVar
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mem_mcp.db import tenant_tx
from mem_mcp.mcp.tool_descriptions import TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._base import BaseTool, ToolContext
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._mindmap_common import resolve_team_id
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._work_item_common import (
    WorkItemListOutput,
    map_work_item_error,
)
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_work_get import build_with_moves
from mem_mcp.mindmap import work_items as work_item_service
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_errors import WorkflowError
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_reads import compute_item_moves


class MindmapWorkListInput(BaseModel):
    """Input for listing a map's work items."""

    map_key: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    team_id: UUID | None = Field(default=None)


class MindmapWorkListTool(BaseTool):
    """List work items of a map, each with current_stage and allowed_moves."""

    name: ClassVar[str] = "mindmap_work_list"
    description: ClassVar[str] = TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS["mindmap_work_list"]
    required_scope: ClassVar[str] = "memory.read"
    InputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = MindmapWorkListInput
    OutputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = WorkItemListOutput

    async def __call__(self, ctx: ToolContext, inp: BaseModel) -> BaseModel:
        assert isinstance(inp, MindmapWorkListInput)

        async with tenant_tx(ctx.db_pool, ctx.tenant_id) as conn:
            team_id = await resolve_team_id(conn, ctx, inp.team_id)
            try:
                items = await work_item_service.list_work_items(
                    conn,
                    tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                    team_id=team_id,
                    map_key=inp.map_key,
                )
                out = []
                for wi in items:
                    moves = await compute_item_moves(
                        conn,
                        tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                        team_id=team_id,
                        map_key=inp.map_key,
                        node_id=wi.memory_id,
                        viewing_tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                    )
                    out.append(build_with_moves(wi, moves, inp.map_key, ctx.request_id))
            except (work_item_service.WorkItemError, WorkflowError) as e:
                raise map_work_item_error(e) from e

            return WorkItemListOutput(items=out, request_id=ctx.request_id)
EOF
